children: G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. (NASDAQ:GIII) is expanding its brand portfolio and growth profile: it formed a 50/50 JV with WHP Global to co-own Marc Jacobs while leading its wholesale, retail and e‑commerce, and projects Q3 and FY2027 EPS/sales growth alongside a DKNY Fall 2026 campaign rollout.
G-III Acquires Marc Jacobs Operating Business
: G-III Apparel acquired the Marc Jacobs operating business, formed a 50/50 JV with WHP Global to co-own Marc Jacobs IP; G-III will lead wholesale, retail and e‑commerce and provide support services.
G-III Forecasts Q3, FY2027 EPS, Sales
: G-III Apparel (GIII) forecasts Q3 adjusted EPS $1.35–$1.45 on about $870M sales; FY2027 GAAP EPS $4.10–$4.20, adjusted $2.20–$2.30, full-year sales ~$2.71B, gross margin +400 bps
: G-III Apparel (GIII) launches DKNY Fall 2026 campaign Sept 1, 2026, featuring models Iris Law and Amelia Gray, shot by Mikael Jansson, highlighting DKNY’s NYC identity across global DKNY channels.
